# Report information

Focused **LC-MS / identification QC** report (RT / 1k0 / m/z distributions,
Score and mass-error QC, PTM profile) for immunopeptidomics experiments,
provided by the Immunopeptidomics Platform (IPP). Intended for advanced users.

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()`

**Code version:** `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")`

```{r child = system.file("rmarkdown", "shared", "setup.Rmd", package = "HowMaHiCo")}
```


# Peptide ID distribution across RT, 1/k0 and m/z {.tabset}

## All peptides {.tabset}

### n_Peptides Vs RT (Pseudochromatograms)

```{r plot-chromato-all, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
chromato_pep_all <- plot_pseudochromatogram(pep_all,
  "Peptide ID chromatogram: All peptides identified", ncol = phis_ncol)
chromato_pep_all
```

### 1/k0 VS m/z

```{r plot-invk0-mz-all, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_invk0_mz_all <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_all, "m_z", "invk0", c(10, 0.025),
  "All peptides identified", x_lab = "m/z", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_invk0_mz_all
```

### 1/k0 VS RT

```{r plot-invk0-rt-all, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_invk0_rt_all <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_all, "RT", "invk0", c(1, 0.025),
  "All peptides identified", x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_invk0_rt_all
```

### m/z VS RT

```{r plot-mz-rt-all, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_mz_rt_all <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_all, "RT", "m_z", c(1, 10),
  "All peptides identified", x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "m/z", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_mz_rt_all
```

## Selected peptides {.tabset}

### n_Peptides Vs RT (Pseudochromatograms)

```{r plot-chromato-short, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
chromato_pep_short <- plot_pseudochromatogram(pep_short,
  paste0("Peptide ID chromatogram: Selected peptides (",
         shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"), ncol = phis_ncol)
chromato_pep_short
```

### 1/k0 VS m/z

```{r plot-invk0-mz-short, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_invk0_mz_short <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_short, "m_z", "invk0", c(10, 0.025),
  paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"),
  x_lab = "m/z", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_invk0_mz_short
```

### 1/k0 VS RT

```{r plot-invk0-rt-short, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_invk0_rt_short <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_short, "RT", "invk0", c(1, 0.025),
  paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"),
  x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "1/k0", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_invk0_rt_short
```

### m/z VS RT

```{r plot-mz-rt-short, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
hm_pep_mz_rt_short <- plot_2d_distribution(pep_short, "RT", "m_z", c(1, 10),
  paste0("Selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"),
  x_lab = "RT (min)", y_lab = "m/z", ncol = phis_ncol)
hm_pep_mz_rt_short
```


# Identification QC

## Score per Condition {.tabset}

### Violin & boxplots

```{r plot-qc-score-violin, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
vp_score_score <- plot_qc_violin(pep_all, "Score", "Score distribution, and boxplot")
vp_score_score
```

### Boxplots

```{r plot-qc-score-box, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
bp_score_score <- plot_qc_box(pep_all, "Score", "Score boxplot")
bp_score_score
```

## Mass eror per condition and charge {.tabset}

### Violin & boxplots

```{r plot-qc-masserror-violin, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
vp_masserror_ppm <- plot_qc_violin(pep_all, "ppm", "Mass error distribution, and boxplot")
vp_masserror_ppm
```

### Boxplots alone

```{r plot-qc-masserror-box, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
bp_masserror_ppm <- plot_qc_box(pep_all, "ppm", "Mass error boxplot")
bp_masserror_ppm
```


```{r export-results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_input_params(params, folder = FolderResults, prefix = "05_lcms_qc")

if (params$PlotsSave) {
  ggsave_rawr(chromato_pep_all, file = "chromato_pep_all", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 10, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_invk0_mz_all, file = "hm_pep_invk0_mz_all", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_invk0_rt_all, file = "hm_pep_invk0_rt_all", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_mz_rt_all, file = "hm_pep_mz_rt_all", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(chromato_pep_short, file = "chromato_pep_short", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 10, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_invk0_mz_short, file = "hm_pep_invk0_mz_short", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_invk0_rt_short, file = "hm_pep_invk0_rt_short", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(hm_pep_mz_rt_short, file = "hm_pep_mz_rt_short", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(vp_score_score, file = "vp_score_score", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(vp_masserror_ppm, file = "vp_masserror_ppm", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_score_score, file = "bp_score_score", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_masserror_ppm, file = "bp_masserror_ppm", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 12)
}
```

results folder) and the full R session are recorded below so this HTML report is
self-documenting and reproducible.

  Parameter = names(params),
  Value = vapply(params, function(x) paste(format(x), collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  row.names = NULL
) |>
  kable() |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE)
